title: Upload a Document to Document Records
goal: Add a document to the right employee's Document Records, under the right type.
context: Screen steps are taken from the HCM job aid 'Uploading Documents to the Document Records Module in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 2/19/25). DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the 'have the file ready' checkpoint and the follow-up reminder describe sensible practice but are not from a published SOP. Confirm them and the contacts with the HCM Academy team.

steps.title: Have the file ready
steps.instruction: Have the file saved, and know the date it was issued.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.instruction: Search for the employee from Home.
steps.expect: The employee shows in the results.
steps.why: A document on the wrong person shows in their record.
hints: Similar names are the top mistake. Match the person number.

steps.title: Open Document Records
steps.instruction: Click the arrow by their name. Choose Document Records. Click Add.
steps.expect: It asks what type of document.

steps.title: Pick the document type
steps.expect: You see Name, Issued On and Attachments.
steps.why: The type decides where it's filed, and if PCB must approve it.
hints: Letters about pay: Compensation Letters. Reviews: Performance Review. Leave: Leave and Accommodation Documentation.

steps.title: Read the description
steps.instruction: Read the note under the type.
steps.expect: You know if this type has its own rules.
steps.why: Some types have rules shown only here.

steps.title: Enter the issue date
steps.instruction: Enter the date on the document.
hints: Use the date on the document, not today.

check.question: Which date goes in Issued On?
options: The date the document was issued
check.why: Issued On is when it was issued or delivered.

steps.title: Attach the file
steps.expect: The file name shows in Attachments.

steps.title: Right file?
steps.instruction: Check the file name. Right document, right person?
steps.why: Easy to fix now. Hard after you submit.

steps.title: Submit
hints: If it needs PCB approval, you'll see a notice.

callouts.say: Issued On is the date the document was issued or delivered. It's usually on the document.
callouts.source: Uploading Documents to the Document Records Module in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 2/19/25

callouts.say: Some types need PCB approval before they show. You get a notice when you submit, and another when PCB approves.
callouts.source: Uploading Documents to the Document Records Module in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 2/19/25

reminders.say: Check that the document now shows in the employee's Document Records. If it needed PCB approval and you have not had the approval notification, follow up.

recap.summary: You filed the document on the right employee, under the right type, with its name and issue date.
nextSteps: If the upload needed PCB approval, watch for the approval notification.
Check the document shows in the employee's Document Records.
